title_sq: Tek Mozaiku I Tiranes, Shitet Ambient Komercial Buze Rruge !
description_sq: Tek Mozaiku i Tiranes, ne rrugen Naim Frasheri, shitet Ambient Komercial, ne katin zero te nje pallati te ri. Ambienti ka siperfaqe neto prej 130 m2 dhe eshte i pozicionuar shume mire ne nje zone me intensitet te konsiderueshem komercial, me pamje te plote nga rruga kryesore, e cila ka trafik te larte kembesoresh dhe makinash. Struktura e ambientit eshte shume funksionale dhe praktike, pa kollona te ndermjetme dhe perfshin nje ambient te madh openspace, nje zyre te vogel si dhe tualetin. Duke qene se eshte buze rruge te jep mundesin ta shrfytezosh per biznese te ndryshme, si studio te ndryshme, qendra estetike, call center, sherbim katering, magazine, etj. Momentalisht prona eshte e dhene me qira 1,000 Euro ne muaj.
title_en: At Mozaik I Tirana, Street Side Commercial Space For Sale!
description_en: At Mozaik i Tirana, on Naim Frasheri Street, Commercial Space is for sale, on the ground floor of a new building. The environment has a net surface of 130 m2 and is very well positioned in an area with considerable commercial intensity, with a full view of the main road, which has high pedestrian and car traffic. The structure of the environment is very functional and practical, without intermediate columns and includes a large open space environment, a small office and the toilet. Since it is on the side of the road, it gives you the opportunity to use it for different businesses, such as different studios, aesthetic centers, call centers, catering services, warehouses, etc. Currently, the property is rented for 1,000 Euro per month.
